quotes.name: Dame Sarr
quotes.quote: I heard the Oaks are 0-3 in preseason, but I don't really follow basketball that closely—just know Dame Sarr plays for them.

quotes.name: Coen Carr
quotes.quote: I’ve heard Dame Sarr’s been putting in work, but the Oaks’ preseason record isn’t where we want it to be. We’ve got to step it up.

quotes.name: Ernesto Quintero
quotes.quote: I’ve heard folks around Baylight talking about Dame Sarr’s hustle—7 points, 3 rebounds, and 3 steals—but the Oaks’ 0-3 preseason record has everyone a little on edge.

claim: I heard the Oaks are 0-3 in preseason, but I don't really follow basketball that closely—just know Dame Sarr plays for them.
